fields.text: I already have a legacy CRM. Can you build something to replace it?

Yes! I have extensive experience replacing legacy enterprise software with custom, fast, and modern web applications. We can replicate your current necessary features while adding the automations you’ve been missing.
Will the web app be mobile-friendly?

Yes. In today’s market, most real estate searches and asset management tasks happen on the go. Your application will be fully responsive and perform flawlessly across all devices—desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
Can you build a dashboard that integrates with my existing data?
Absolutely. I can develop custom Property Management Dashboards that sync with your existing APIs or legacy databases, giving you a modern, unified interface to manage your assets efficiently.
Do you provide the IDX subscription or hosting?

I handle all the technical implementation, development, and integration. You will need to provide your own IDX Broker or MLS credentials and hosting account, but I am happy to guide you through selecting the best providers for your specific needs.
Can you build custom calculators for mortgage brokers?
Yes, I can build advanced, interactive tools such as mortgage payment calculators, loan-to-value (LTV) estimators, and property valuation logic tailored to your specific loan products.
